name: Orzhov Syndicate
description: The Orzhov Syndicate is a white-black Ravnican guild of religion, banking and organized crime, in which the dead exist as capital and debts bind beyond death.

description_citations.text: "Orzhov Syndicate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: The Orzhov Syndicate is a white-black Ravnican guild of religion, banking and organized crime, in which the dead exist as capital and debts bind beyond death.

citations.text: "Orzhov Syndicate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: It was long ruled by the ghostly Ghost Council of the Obzedat, holds its members in debt, and employs thrulls as servants.

citations.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.
"It's Not a Discard Pile". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.
"Magic's Exclusive Creatures". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: After the Guildpact was broken, Teysa Karlov helped draft a new non-magical agreement and became the first Grand Envoy of the Orzhov.

citations.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Grand envoy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Its relations with other guilds were often hostile: the Boros accused it of violating a boundary contract, and Domri's ragebeasts drove it out of the Rubblebelt.

citations.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.
"Domri Rade", section "Joining the Gruul". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Nicol Bolas hired Kaya to kill the Obzedat, and she did so and became guildmaster through a loophole.

citations.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the War of the Spark the Orzhov triumvirate, persuaded by Bilagru, agreed to join Kaya's fight against Bolas.

citations.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After the Phyrexian invasion the guild profited from the disorder with loans at exorbitant interest, and Teysa usurped Kaya's position as guildmaster while Kaya defended the Multiverse.

citations.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Covetous Elegy (Ravnica: Clue Edition, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Kaya Cassir", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: At the Karlov Manor gala the dead of the guild remained loyal to Teysa, who continues to run the Syndicate as a ghost.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past

status.text: As of the Murders at Karlov Manor story the guild is run by Teysa Karlov as a ghost, and it has grown richer from wartime loans.

timeline.summary: Orzhov start using hawks as messengers to bypass toll roads, creating a profitable business.
timeline.quote: The Orzhov started using hawks as messengers in order to bypass the many toll roads and bridges that dot Ravnica.

citation.text: Courier Hawk (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Czaric argues for outliving mortal law through undeath.
timeline.quote: Why limit yourself to mortal law when you can outlive those who enforce it?

citation.text: Strands of Undeath (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the Guildpact is broken, Teysa Karlov drafts a new non-magical document for cooperation.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov of the Orzhov Syndicate drafted a new, non-magical document amongst the guilds

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The guilds return to ascendance; most get new guildmasters except the Izzet, Orzhov and Rakdos.
timeline.quote: the guilds returned and became ascendant

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gruul ravage the streets while Teysa leads the Orzhov Syndicate to cleanse them.
timeline.quote: Teysa leads the Orzhov Syndicate to "cleanse" them.

citation.text: "Guildpact", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Dissension Teysa helps draft a new non-magical Guildpact and becomes the first Grand Envoy of the Orzhov.
timeline.quote: has been made the first and only Grand Envoy of the Orzhov Syndicate

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Grand envoy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Relov signs an Orzhov enforcer's urgent application despite twelve statute violations when he sees the bribe amount.
timeline.quote: The request violated twelve statutes, but when Relov saw the pale pink number printed at the bottom, he signed without hesitation.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: After Razia's death, the Boros work as hired guards, mostly for Orzhov families, under guildmaster Feather.
timeline.quote: the Boros mainly worked as paid bodyguards and security officials for the highest bidders, mostly Orzhov families

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The Interregnum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orzhov thugs harass Busa in front of Boros patrolmen, raising the protection rate.
timeline.quote: Today they doubled the rate and said they'd cut my daughter's toes off if I didn't pay on time.

citation.text: "Rogue's Passage". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Nov 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Domri hurls a stone through the cathedral's Orzhov window, and the friends make glass daggers.
timeline.quote: let the stone fly

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Domri commands ragebeasts to drive the Orzhov out of the Rubblebelt; Borborygmos makes him an honorary Burning Tree member.
timeline.quote: The cyclops declared Domri an honorary member of the Burning Tree clan.

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Joining the Gruul". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bosco tells Drovo he has taken on five centuries of debt to join the Orzhov.
timeline.quote: "That's how much debt I owe to the guild. Five centuries all told."

citation.text: "The Guild of Deals". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Symond is arrested by Azorius arresters over a body, and sees a cloaked Orzhov rider on a horse as he is taken away.
timeline.quote: Symond found himself being ushered away under the guard of a half dozen arresters.

citation.text: "Bilagru Will Come for You". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: An Orzhov cleric tells a visiting scribe that his order is a gateway for life.
timeline.quote: "I am a gateway for life," the cleric said.

citation.text: "Behind the Black Sun". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The cleric invites the scribe to follow him to the sanctum.
timeline.quote: "Walk with me to the sanctum."

citation.text: "Behind the Black Sun". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The cleric shows the scribe the Deathpact, namesake of his order.
timeline.quote: "This is the Deathpact," he said

citation.text: "Behind the Black Sun". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The cleric scatters handfuls of coins around himself as part of the ritual.
timeline.quote: reached in to scatter handfuls of coins around him on the floor

citation.text: "Behind the Black Sun". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The smoke of the Deathpact enters the cleric's nostrils and he crumples.
timeline.quote: the smoke lunged into the cleric's nostrils and vanished

citation.text: "Behind the Black Sun". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The cleric's body withers as a winged, scythe-bearing angel forms from the smoke, coins and gold.
timeline.quote: The cleric's body shriveled and desiccated before my eyes

citation.text: "Behind the Black Sun". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The angel orders the scribe to write down her message.
timeline.quote: "You. Orzhov scribe. Write this."

citation.text: "Behind the Black Sun". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The angel delivers a message from the ghost halls of the Obzedat for Teysa Karlov.
timeline.quote: I have come from the ghost halls of the Obzedat with a message for Teysa Karlov.

citation.text: "Behind the Black Sun". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The angel says Teysa Karlov must complete the maze at all costs.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov must find the correct route and complete the maze at all costs.

citation.text: "Behind the Black Sun". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Tajic scouts with a platoon, linking with Orzhov patrols that, through Teysa Karlov, helped root out Dimir sleeper cells; the Obzedat agree to shared protection of the Ninth.
timeline.quote: the Boros and Orzhov would share protection duties over the Ninth

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives late at the Chamber of the Guildpact to find Boros minotaurs complaining that the Orzhov have violated a boundary contract.
timeline.quote: The Orzhov violated our boundary contract!

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Mr. Taz offers Krenko another job at an Orzhov bank, and an Izzet portal opens nearby.
timeline.quote: an Izzet experiment unintentionally opened a portal nearby

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Working for Mr. Taz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Terrik uses bramble seeds to stop an Orzhov thug trying to sell him insurance, then reaches the orphanage near the ruined basilica.
timeline.quote: thorny vines erupt from the sidewalk, entangling my pursuer in their scratchy embrace.

citation.text: "Bound and Bonded" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Orzhov vampires look for allies in case their new guildmaster turns on them after the fate of the Obzedat.
timeline.quote: The fate of the Obzedat is proof of Kaya's power and her hatred of the living dead.

citation.text: Vizkopa Vampire (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas hires Kaya to kill the Obzedat and become Orzhov guildmaster.
timeline.quote: Bolas hired her to kill the Obzedat and become guildmaster of Orzhov

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills the Ghost Council and becomes guildmaster through a loophole.
timeline.quote: she had become the new guildmaster of the Syndicate

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Utvara is devastated by a Simic-origin plague worsened by Gruul encroachment and is declared a reclamation zone.
timeline.quote: Utvara was devastated by a Simic -origin plague.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A scavenger uncovers a buried city, sparking illegal prospecting financed by the Orzhov and an unlawful shantytown.
timeline.quote: a scavenger uncovered a vast buried city beneath the brickwork

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Izzet return after discovering three unhatched dragon eggs and build the Cauldron.
timeline.quote: the Izzet established the Cauldron , a massive steamworks complex built into the Utvara Flats

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat, Teyo and Kaya meet the Orzhov triumvirate, and Bilagru convinces them to join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Orzhov triumvirate agrees to join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Swayed by Bilagru's arguments, the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orzhov elites reluctantly agree to help Kaya fight Bolas.
timeline.quote: Despite their disdain for her (due to her policy of forgiving debts and raising taxes), they reluctantly agreed to help her in the fight against Bolas.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teyo and Rat rally the Orzhov Syndicate after Bilagru convinces the triumvirate.
timeline.quote: the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska welcomes curious Simic and Izzet volunteers while others flee in terror.
timeline.quote: I motion to welcome them.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Teysa Karlov usurps Kaya's position as Orzhov guildmaster while Kaya defends the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Kaya retained her spark through the Desparkening

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the invasion the Orzhov profit from the disorder with loans at exorbitant interest.
timeline.quote: However, once the threat was eliminated, they acted quickly to capitalize on the disorder and uncertainty that followed.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Orzhov launch an extravagant fireworks display above Karlov Manor to open the gala.
timeline.quote: The sky over Karlov Manor danced with a dizzying array of colors, brought to life by shimmering cascades of magic.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: The Orzhov dead pledge to tell investigators that this was not a power struggle with Kaya.
timeline.quote: We will tell the lawmages and investigators who are bound to come that this was not a power struggle between past and present leaders

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: The Orzhov pontiff Medori transformed Medori Park from a city park into warehouse lots.
timeline.quote: once a city park transformed into warehouse lots by the Orzhov pontiff Medori

citation.text: "Precinct Six", section "Locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Orzhov grow wealthier from exorbitant interest on wartime loans.
timeline.quote: Wealthier than ever thanks to exorbitant interest on wartime loans, the Orzhov only grew hungrier for more.

citation.text: Covetous Elegy (Ravnica: Clue Edition, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Echoverse Niv-Mizzet bankrupts the Orzhov Syndicate with life-insurance policies and takes a seat on the Ghost Council.
timeline.quote: he all but bankrupted the Orzhov Syndicate and bought himself a seat on the Ghost Council.

citation.text: "Izzet League", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bosco recruits his friend Drovo to a mission, boasting of his debt and guild benefits.
timeline.quote: Bosco set about recruiting him to a mission.

citation.text: "Bosco", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bosco signs a new contract in the high prelate's office with Jozica, erasing years of debt and giving a promotion.
timeline.quote: signing a new contract that would erase years of his debt and give him a promotion

citation.text: "Bosco", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bosco reports success to the high prelate, is promoted to mission runner and no longer fears Jozica.
timeline.quote: Bosco had been promoted to a mission runner for the high prelate

citation.text: "Bosco", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Schism mutates the plague into an airborne plague wind; the guilds respond.
timeline.quote: mutating it to become airborne

citation.text: "Creation of the Schism", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Over 126 years Emilya learns the Orzhov used her death to gather wealth, and becomes a Rusalka.
timeline.quote: Emilya discovered that the Orzhov used her death to manipulate and gather wealth

citation.text: "Emilya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A colossal stone entity returns Emilya to life; she plans to expose the Orzhov.
timeline.quote: Emilya was miraculously returned to life by a mysterious, colossal stone entity

citation.text: "Emilya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The guilds fight internally over whether to follow Bolas's influence; in the end five fall under his influence and five do not.
timeline.quote: In the end, five fall under his influence, and five don't.

citation.text: "Guilds of Ravnica block", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet bankrupted the Orzhov through life-insurance policies and bought himself a seat on the Ghost Council.
timeline.quote: he all but bankrupted the Orzhov Syndicate and bought himself a seat on the Ghost Council.

citation.text: "Obzedat", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa asked Tajic to help remove the Obzedat; the plot failed and the Orzhov imprisoned him until Aurelia freed him.
timeline.quote: Tajic was taken prisoner by the Orzhov

citation.text: "Tajic", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
